purpose: Authorize exactly the write surface needed to install the already-implemented, already-tested Phase-4 GPT<->Hermes control kernel from its evidence staging tree into orchestration/hermes/bridge/. This package authorizes the install; it does not perform it.

current_blocker.symptom: orchestration/hermes/bridge/ is inside the project root and listed in no active allowed_paths, so the Contract Guard returns UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED for every write to it.
current_blocker.resolution: This package lists orchestration/hermes/bridge/ in allowed_paths. The install session activates it by exporting HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE=<this package directory>; config.yaml and the guard source are unchanged.

staged_implementation.test_result: 34/34 bridge tests passed during the Phase-4 run
staged_implementation.note: Do not redesign or rewrite. The install is a verbatim copy plus a test run plus a parity proof.

install_target.overwrite: the Phase-3 adapter is superseded by the staged Phase-4 adapter

read_first.why: state why the kernel is staged and what the install command and precondition are
the HERMES_TASK_V1 / HERMES_RESULT_V1 envelope being installed
persistent state, replay journal and single-worker lock
contract-package gate and guarded execution path
the one-round entry point being installed
the Phase-4 adapter carrying the send-semantics fix that supersedes the Phase-3 copy
the deterministic suite that must pass against the installed tree
the only pre-existing file at the install target, confirming the tracked overwrite

boundary_notes.resolution: allowed_paths and forbidden_paths are project-relative to the Contract Guard source_root, as in the P0B-CLOSE and earlier contracts; an entry is a directory prefix or an exact file.
boundary_notes.no_overlap: No allowed path is equal to, inside, or a parent of any forbidden path; the compiler reports zero E_PATH_CONFLICT.
boundary_notes.unlisted_is_blocked: Any path inside the project root matching neither list stays BLOCKED (UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED), which protects KeepLab code, the compiler, the guard and every historical artifact.
boundary_notes.not_guard_enforceable: The Hermes profile config.yaml and the pinned Hermes source sit outside the guard source_root; they are declared read-only by this contract and are proven unchanged by pre/post sha256 equality.
boundary_notes.no_broad_access: No path above the two authorized directories is allow-listed; /mnt/AndroidDev/Projects itself is never an allowed path.
